summaries.en: Add a keyless Desktop phone Electron acceptance lane and configurable mobilecli server port.
summaries.zh: 新增无需密钥的桌面手机 Electron 验收通道与可配置的 mobilecli 服务端口。

summaries.en: Render the Desktop phone tab's H264 stream as a visible, interactive device picture.
summaries.zh: 在桌面端手机 tab 中把 H264 流渲染为可见且可交互的设备画面。

summaries.en: Wait for Desktop workbench settings registration before serving the phone overlay.
summaries.zh: 桌面端手机浮层在工作台设置注册完成后再提供服务。

summaries.en: Align phone documentation and static-analysis ownership without changing product runtime behavior.
summaries.zh: 校准手机功能文档与静态分析归属，不改变产品运行时行为。

summaries.en: Make consecutive documentation site builds replace their own prior output safely.
summaries.zh: 让连续文档站构建安全替换自身的上次输出。

summaries.en: Include the phone device runtime chunks required by Desktop invariant diagnostics.
summaries.zh: 在 Desktop 产物中携带手机设备运行时不变量诊断所需的分片。

summaries.en: Publish dynamic browser factories with an explicit CommonJS extension while preserving their browser routes.
summaries.zh: 以明确的 CommonJS 扩展名发布动态浏览器 factory，同时保持其浏览器路由。

summaries.en: Share the Desktop phone reconnect card without changing its interaction behavior.
summaries.zh: 复用桌面端手机重连卡片，不改变交互行为。

summaries.en: Complete phone CI and tool-catalog projections and the CLI request-trust and phone-tool runtime dependency closure.
summaries.zh: 补全手机能力的 CI 与工具目录投影，并闭合 CLI 的 request-trust 与手机工具运行时依赖。

summaries.en: Complete behavior coverage without exclusions for every phone-runtime, phone-stream, and ui-phone source file.
summaries.zh: 在不使用排除项的前提下补齐 phone-runtime、phone-stream 与 ui-phone 全部源文件的行为覆盖率。

summaries.en: Make the phone-runtime fake mobilecli launcher executable in native Windows tests.
summaries.zh: 让 phone-runtime 的 fake mobilecli launcher 可在原生 Windows 测试中执行。

summaries.en: Close the contracts-ready lint debt across the delivered Desktop phone surface.
summaries.zh: 清零已交付 Desktop 手机能力面的 contracts-ready lint 债务。

summaries.en: Let the Desktop Web development watcher resolve package-declared TSX client entries.
summaries.zh: 让 Desktop Web 开发 watcher 解析包显式声明的 TSX client 入口。

summaries.en: Align Phone Devices Web snapshots and cross-platform CI fixtures, and complete the Desktop CLI phone-stream installation closure.
summaries.zh: 校准手机设备 Web 快照与跨平台 CI fixture，并补全 Desktop CLI 的 phone-stream 安装闭包。

summaries.en: Let Desktop prepare, verify, and hot-activate the pinned mobilecli runtime from Phone Devices settings.
summaries.zh: 让 Desktop 从「手机设备」设置中准备、校验并热激活固定版本的 mobilecli 运行时。

summaries.en: Let Desktop prepare and start a pinned Android SDK, API 35 image, and private default emulator.
summaries.zh: 让 Desktop 准备并启动固定 Android SDK、API 35 镜像与私有默认模拟器。

summaries.en: Let Desktop prepare and start an iOS Simulator, prepare the iOS device-control agent, and explain actionable physical-iPhone readiness failures.
summaries.zh: 让 Desktop 准备并启动 iOS 模拟器、准备 iOS 设备控制代理，并为 iPhone 真机就绪失败提供可操作说明。

summaries.en: Show each phone once and fall back to a controllable MJPEG picture when its H264 stream is unusable.
summaries.zh: 每台手机只展示一次，并在 H264 画面不可用时回退到可控制的 MJPEG 画面。

summaries.en: Encode Desktop phone-tab swipes as WDA destination-move travel pauses so iOS Simulator UI scrolls.
summaries.zh: 把桌面端手机 tab 的 swipe 编成 WDA 终点位移时长手势，使 iOS Simulator 界面可以滚动。

summaries.en: Preserve durable assistant interruption so Mobile Companion renders the existing stopped marker in paged history and live replacements.
summaries.zh: 保留持久 assistant 中断标记，使 Mobile Companion 在分页历史与实时替换中显示既有停止标记。
